mapper.update: WITH current_task AS ( SELECT id, execution_generation FROM kb_parse_task WHERE version_id = #{versionId} AND status <> 'running' AND (status = 'failed' OR attempts >= max_attempts OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_parse_task_dead_letter dl WHERE dl.task_id = kb_parse_task.id AND dl.status = 'OPEN')) FOR UPDATE ), closed_dead_letters AS ( UPDATE kb_parse_task_dead_letter dl SET status = 'REPLAYED', resolved_at = now(), resolution_reason = '用户请求重新解析' FROM current_task c WHERE dl.task_id = c.id AND dl.status = 'OPEN' ) UPDATE kb_parse_task t SET status = 'pending', attempts = 0, next_attempt_at = now(), lease_until = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, failure_class = NULL, failure_code = NULL, failure_summary = NULL, last_failure_at = NULL, last_error = NULL, execution_generation = t.execution_generation + 1, claim_token = t.claim_token + 1, embedding_profile_id = NULL, embedding_epoch = NULL, updated_at = now() FROM current_task c WHERE t.id = c.id
UPDATE kb_document_version SET index_status = 'pending', index_error = NULL WHERE id = #{versionId} AND index_status <> 'indexed'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_parse_task_event (task_id, version_id, execution_generation, attempt_no, event_type, actor_user_id, error_summary, dedupe_key) SELECT id, version_id, execution_generation, attempts, 'REPLAYED', #{actorUserId}, left(#{reason}, 2000), 'user-retry:' || id || ':' || execution_generation FROM kb_parse_task WHERE version_id = #{versionId} ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO NOTHING
